result:
The proposed answer of 282 is incorrect. I checked it by factoring directly.

Since a = −10 (from the x³ coefficient), the two roots r₁, r₂ = (−10 + bi ± √(c+di))/2 have sum −10 + bi. So P factors over ℂ as

P = (x² + (10 − bi)x + u)(x² + (10 + bi)x + ū), with u = p + qi.

Matching coefficients gives:
- x²: 2p + 100 + b² = 29, so p = −(71 + b²)/2.
- x: 20p − 2bq = −666, so bq = −22 − 5b².
- constant: p² + q² = 2025.

Testing b = 2 (the proposed value): p = −37.5 and q = −21, so p² + q² = 1406.25 + 441 = 1847.25 ≠ 2025. This fails, so b = 2 is wrong. The proposed solution's derived equations did not hold up.

Testing b = 1: p = −36 and q = −27, so p² + q² = 1296 + 729 = 2025 ✓.

The factor is x² + (10 − i)x − 36 − 27i. Its roots are

x = [−10 + i ± √((10 − i)² + 144 + 108i)]/2 = [−10 + i ± √(243 + 88i)]/2.

Here √(243 + 88i) ≈ 16 + 2.75i. With the + sign, the real part is about (−10 + 16)/2 = 3 and the imaginary part is about (1 + 2.75)/2 > 0, so this root is in the first quadrant.

This gives a = −10, b = 1, c = 243, d = 88, so a + b + c + d = 322.

VERDICT: REJECT
